urdu: راج سنگھ چودھری نے کونسی فلم لکھی اور ہدایت کی جو 2022 میں ریلیز ہوئی؟
english: Which film did Raj Singh Chaudhary write and direct that was released in 2022?
roman_1: Raj Singh Chaudhary ne konsi film likhi aur hadayat ki jo 2022 mein release hui?
roman_2: Raj Singh Chaudhary ne konsi film likhi aur direct ki jo 2022 main release hui?
roman_3: Raj Singh Chaudhary ne konsi film likhi aur direction di jo 2022 may release hui?
